# RPG World

> RPG World (https://rpgworldapp.com) is a free, open-source web app for creating and managing
> tabletop RPG character sheets, starting with Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition (SRD 5.1). It is
> available in English and Brazilian Portuguese, works on desktop and phone, and is licensed under
> the GNU GPLv3. In Portuguese: um app gratuito e de código aberto para fichas de personagem de RPG
> de mesa, começando por D&D 5e, em português do Brasil e inglês.

RPG World is for players who want a digital character sheet that does the math for them, and who
want to play in Portuguese without depending on English-only tools. It is an independent project
by Rebeca Morais (Rebs Tech Studio), not affiliated with or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.

## What you can do today

- Create D&D 5e characters and keep them in your account, available on any device.
- Fill a single-page character sheet: ability scores, saving throws, skills (with proficiency and
  expertise), armor class, initiative, speed, hit dice, hit points, temporary hit points and death
  saves.
- Let the sheet calculate modifiers, proficiency bonus and passive perception automatically.
- Track magic with spell slots or spell points.
- Build a spellbook from the 319 spells of the SRD 5.1, with search and filters by level, school,
  class and damage type, in English and Brazilian Portuguese; mark spells as prepared.
- Write the character's story: appearance, personality traits, ideals, bonds, flaws and backstory.
- Personalize each character with an avatar and an accent color.

## Planned (not available yet)

- Parties and campaigns with Dungeon Master and player roles, session notes and scheduling.
- Inventory and items.
- More game systems (D&D 2024 rules and others) and more languages.
- Homebrew content of any type (spells, items, classes, backgrounds), shareable with a party or
  the community under CC-BY-4.0.

## Facts

- Price: free. Sign up with email or Google.
- Languages: English, Português (Brasil).
- Systems: Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition (SRD 5.1).
- Source code: https://github.com/rebecamorais/rpg-world (GNU GPLv3). Anyone can self-host.
- Game content: System Reference Document 5.1 by Wizards of the Coast LLC, under CC-BY-4.0.
  Portuguese spell translations by the Foundry VTT Brasil community (MIT). Full credits in the
  repository's NOTICE.md.
